subject: Deal data grooming: cleanse for Q4 forecast accuracy
messages:
From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 18 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Deal data grooming: cleanse for Q4 forecast accuracy

Team —

Finance ran a quick simulation this morning and the Q4 forecast variance looks larger than we'd like. Before the Friday commit we need to do a short grooming sprint on a small set of deals that are contributing the most to noise. Primary asks: amount verification, SKU/product mapping, next-step clarity (what to expect this week), and updated probability.

I attached a short CSV that lists the top 18 deals by ARR variance (Q4_deal_list.csv) and a one-page checklist (grooming-checklist.pdf). Please do the following by EOD Monday: 

- Each deal owner should confirm the ARR amount and currency (note any credit/discounts in comments).
- Validate product/SKU selection; if there's ambiguity, mark preferred SKU and link to the product catalog entry.
- Replace vague next steps ("on hold", "waiting") with specific milestones or remove the close date if not realistic.
- Re-evaluate probability; pick a rationale code: (A) legal signoff pending, (B) procurement in review, (C) POC dependency, (D) customer budget/renewal.

I'll coordinate with Finance on how changes feed into the commit. Rishi — can you run the quick variance re-sim once updates are in (should take <30m)? Ben/Marissa — you two are the owners for the Acme Analytics cluster in the CSV.

Thanks — let's keep the updates terse (one line) in the CRM note and add the checklist tag: #Q4GROOM.

—Irene
Irene Choi
Senior Sales Operations Manager
Redwood Inference

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 21 Sep 2026 08:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Deal data grooming: cleanse for Q4 forecast accuracy

Irene — thanks for the note and the files. Quick status on our side for the Acme Analytics block:

- DEAL-9876 (primary): current amount $375k ARR — need to confirm whether the $25k setup fee was incorrectly included in ARR. I've flagged the deal and uploaded the latest contract (acme_contract_v2.pdf) to the HubSpot deal record.
- SKU ambiguity: Sales rep originally chose "Realtime-Base" but product team recommends "Realtime-Enterprise" for this scope (higher ARR). I will mark SKU as Realtime-Enterprise and add a comment with the product catalog link.
- Next step: Legal needs a countersign; customer procurement confirmed they will return by Wed (procurement@acmeanalytics.com). I'll set the next step to: "Legal countersign expected — customer procurement signoff (Wed)".
- Probability: moving from 60% -> 55% (reason B: procurement in review).

I'll do the CRM notes per the checklist and tag #Q4GROOM before lunchtime. Ben

Great progress — Ben nailed the key items for DEAL-9876. A couple of notes from CS/product that affect probability and timing: 

- The POC kickoff is scheduled for 9/29 per the customer's PM; successful POC is a gating factor for expansion. Change rationale to C for this deal if there are open POC success criteria.
- For ARR calculations, remove one-off implementation fees from ARR and add them to a "one-time" revenue field in the CRM (Finance needs separation).
- If legal countersign is expected this week but POC isn't until next month, we should split the revenue recognition expectation: keep close_date as 2026-09-30 but add CRM note: "POC-dependent expansion post-POC — treat additional ARR as expansion opp".

Action items: 
- Ben: confirm SKU change in CRM and attach product catalog link.
- Rishi: once updates are in, can you run the variance re-sim and paste the short result into this thread (one-line summary)?
- Irene: can you escalate any deals where procurement timelines are uncertain so we can pull in AE for customer commitments?

I'll update the HubSpot deal with the one-time vs ARR split and tag the record. Marissa

Nice work, team — appreciate the quick updates. Summary and next steps (final ask before commit):

- DEAL-9876 (Acme Analytics): ARR confirmed $350k (removed $25k one-time setup), SKU set to Realtime-Enterprise, next step: Legal countersign expected Wed, probability set to 55% (reason B -> procurement review), HubSpot link: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/deal/DEAL-9876. Attachment acme_contract_v2.pdf uploaded to the deal.
- Rishi: please run the variance re-sim now and paste the short output here. We need a one-line delta for the commit deck (e.g., "Q4 commit decreases by $420k ARR driven by two SKU corrections and one contract reclass").
- Marissa: please add the CRM tag #Q4GROOM and create the one-time vs ARR split field update.
- Ben: follow up with procurement@acmeanalytics.com if countersign slips past EOD Wed and escalate to AE.

I'll consolidate results into the commit packet and share with Finance by Wed 17:00 PT. If anyone hits blockers, drop a short note in this thread.

Thanks — Irene
